name: kolo
description: Standalone business apps with optional hosted or self-hosted synchronization

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @kolo/contracts && npm run build -w @kolo/core
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/server && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run boundaries && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run docs:check && npm run build
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kolo/desktop
scripts.dev:server: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @kolo/server
scripts.smoke:credentials: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop && node scripts/smoke-credentials.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop && node scripts/smoke-desktop.mjs
scripts.smoke:server: docker build -f apps/server/Dockerfile -t kolo-server:foundation . && node scripts/smoke-server.mjs
scripts.smoke:desktop:workflow: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop && node scripts/smoke-desktop-workflow.mjs
scripts.stage:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop && node scripts/stage-desktop.mjs
scripts.pack:desktop: npm run stage:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json --dir --publish never
scripts.dist:desktop:win: npm run stage:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.benchmark:desktop: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @kolo/desktop && node scripts/benchmark-desktop.mjs
scripts.dist:desktop:linux: npm run stage:desktop && electron-builder --config apps/desktop/electron-builder.json --linux --x64 --publish never
